All tests pass! ✓

I've successfully added the `create_invoice_handler` function to `invoicing/api.py`. The handler:

- Accepts `service`, `user`, and `body` parameters
- Extracts `id` and `items` from the request body
- Creates `LineItem` objects for each item (which validates qty > 0)
- Creates an `Invoice` object with the user as the customer
- Stores it via `service.create()`
- Returns `(201, {"id", "created"})` on success with ISO 8601 formatted date
- Returns `(400, {"error": code})` if any item is invalid (e.g., bad qty)

All 10 tests pass, including the existing test suite.
